evidence_limits: Native clearance sweeps test 25 routes with all seven supported profiles: 183 checks and 84,448 collision steps.
Actual-tic movement separately traverses four gates and ascends/descends all four towers: 2,248 steps; native gravity retained. Hostile bodies/damage are isolated in traversal fixtures.

Full-battle runs keep 1,000 Mandingas, one commander, 100 defenders and all 24 machines concurrently active. Performance samples measure simulation throughput, not display FPS or a controlled combat outcome.

Travel fixtures seed Ace/Zupay progress and 0/2/4 extracted prisoners, then use native departure, planning, ChangeLevel, arrival, payments and save/reload. This is not a full unaided campaign playthrough.
Siege objective fixtures force guard deaths and the commander threshold to exercise both objective orders and real northern withdrawal, then shared card/reward persistence.
Legacy geometry continues old saves; it does not migrate them into the expanded city. Original saves/packages are retained for rollback.
Early local traversal harness failures were resolved by settling collision sweeps on native floorz and retaining native vertical velocity in actual-tic tests; product movement code was unchanged.
